premises: Cryogenic rolling followed by warm rolling at 600 °C on AlCoCrFeNi2.1 produces a dual heterogeneous microstructure of retained lamellae and nanocrystalline regions.
This dual heterogeneous microstructure yields an unprecedented combination of strength (~2000 MPa) and ductility (~8%).
The nanocrystalline regions act as barriers to crack propagation and enhance grain boundary strengthening.
The preserved lamellar structure continues to contribute to load distribution.
The processing route is applicable to dual-phase lamellar eutectic high-entropy alloys like AlCoCrFeNi2.1.
